description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses or categories to deterministic and theme-based colors, primarily for use in status visualization on dark backgrounds in a dashboard. It includes functions to generate consistent pastel colors from strings and to map common status strings to predefined theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different inputs while keeping saturation and lightness within specified ranges.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color (such as success, error, primary) based on known status categories; for unknown or unrecognized statuses, generates a deterministic color using `colorFromString`.
